The story

EPIISOD Macquarie Park is a design-led student residence where indoor comfort meets lush alfresco courtyards

From the Artisan Café and cinema to the Rooftop Terrace, Wellness Sanctuary, BBQ spaces and vibrant lounges, every corner invites you to gather, unwind and live your story.
